entries.title: Selecting words in a card's diagram no longer opens it larger
entries.body: Dragging across words in a card's diagram now selects them so you can copy them, and the larger view stays shut. A single click on the diagram still opens it at once.
entries.noPicture: The larger view opens in the window's own chrome, outside the card, so a still of the card looks the same with or without the fix.
entries.noDocsSite: The pages say a click on a picture shows it larger, which still holds.
